text: hey can we fix this annoying shit here is my view without xray on [Image #1] and then with xray on [Image #2] notice how without xray im still getting a bunch of bullshit that isnt even in my view showing up
resolution: Root cause: the drawn overlay's visibility mask (mesh_edit.refreshCameraVisibility) only did back-face culling, so front-facing geometry hidden BEHIND nearer surfaces (greebles under the hull, the model's far side) still drew its verts/edges/dots in Surface mode — while the click path already ray-tested real occlusion. Fix: refreshCameraVisibility now builds a screen-space depth grid (front-facing triangles binned by projected bounds, perspective-correct 1/z depth compare, same relative eps as model_paint.occluded) and prunes occluded vertices; edges derive from the pruned verts, and face wash + face dots consult the same grid via overlayPointOccludedPub. Marquee select and pick candidates share this one boundary, so hidden elements also stop catching box-selects. X-Ray unchanged — it deliberately restores everything. 161/161 mesh-edit tests pass incl. the flipped occlusion assertion. Needs a dev-host rebuild (framework change) to see it.
